notes.title: N1 Update (And N2 release date soon!)
notes.content:
Good evening everyone! I forgot to put this on the N2 news and not just the N1 news!

It's been quiet on the steam front for a while, but rest assured we've been working on the game quite publicly. We're mostly active on Twitter and [url=https://discord.gg/CwQS7U6Swz]Discord[/url], but I apologise for being quiet over here. But let me get right to the point!

In preparation for Night Two's release, we're pushing a small update to Night One with some things we've been going back to sort out during N2's development. It's not a lot, only some small tweaks.

Speaking of N2's development... it's ready! Night Two is now in what I consider to be a completed state. We've just gotta talk to the publisher and find out when they want to release it. Plus, steam requires a build to be uploaded to them for compliance, and they have to approve it on their end. That could take a few days or longer, depending on them. The very moment I get a release date from them I'll announce that too! Between now and release, the team is going to be on polishing duty to make it nice and shiny :D

One of those polishing things is pushing an update to N1 with some stuff we've done. I have patch notes below. If it's been a long time since you last played N1, I encourage you to run through again before N2 comes out. I know some of you never even saw the two scenes we added ages ago, with the sexy intro and the ghost in the mirror :O

[list]
[*] Oolay Tigers voice added to N1
[list][*] Alternate Zero Diamonds voice available for N1 in options
[/list][*] Fast forward added in new system
[*] Naomi naughty words added, tell her a naughty word for the keyword for more fun
[*] DJ Cherry Bomb voice added
[*] Sammy game has persistence, feed him as many fries as you want and he'll remember
[*] New sound mixing options
[*] Small Sarah scene added
[*] Corrections done
[*] Effects corrected
[*] Sounds and extra voices added
[*] And more we probably forgot about!
[*] [b]N1 converted to new save system. [u]Old saves will not work in N2[/u], but any saves from this version will transfer[/b] Please keep this in mind, an old save is very likely to cause crashes in N2!
[/list]


I'm really excited to be able to release N2 soon, and I'm endlessly grateful to every last one of you, whether you supported us, joined the community, or even just played the game. I know it's taken us... a lot longer than anyone of us wanted, so once again, thank you for your patience while we worked on our game!

notes.title: Achievements Wave 1, Big Dev Update, and news!
notes.content:
Happy Valentines Day, gamers! Although, for a lot of you it's probably the 15th by now, in which case, Happy Discount Candy Day! 

I've got some stuff to say I'm super excited about this time. First off, Love Sucks: Night One has gotten another update and it should be rolling out now, so here are the patch notes:

[hr][/hr]
Changelog:
-Added the first batch of achievements
-Added in new visual line design

Technical:
-Fixed Music Errors (hopefully)
-New Display system for characters
-Position fixes
-Spelling and grammar changes (keep finding them!)
-Achievement Screens
-Clearing Persistent and Achievement Data
-Fixed the Ghost Scene Unlock
-Several sprite reworks
-Sound and Music Fixes

Sadness:
-Saves had to be wiped to make achievements work right. We'll have to wipe them again in the future for compatibility with Night Two.
[hr][/hr]

Yeah! Achievements! This is actually wave 1 of the achievements, just to make sure they work! There are 15 achievements right now, and we'll add some more not too far into the future. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/423feNT.png[/img]

Oh yeah, it's all coming together. Just a couple more things, then a coat of polish and it'll be ready to go. It will be priced at $14.99, and we're pretty confident it'll be worth it! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719310/Love_Sucks_Night_Two/]Wishlist[/url] us so that you don't miss it!

Third, and this is just for $10+ Patreons, we plan to get you guys a special early build of the game so you can try it out, check for bugs, point out anything we messed up, and probably make memes about it or whatever.  

To any other people interested, your last chance to get your name in the credits will be very soon! Once I gather up everyone's names and put them in the game, I won't be adding anyone else (Please make sure your name on Patreon is the name you want to appear in the credits, as I'll be pulling the names directly from there (Yes, that means that even you, Cock and Ball Torture, will appear in the credits))! You can support the development of Love Sucks right [url=https://www.patreon.com/artwitchstudios]here[/url] <3

Also, an update regarding girl/futa mode for the game. It's still planned, and we'll add it in a big update eventually, but there's no ETA for when it will be added to Nights One or Two yet. It's a lot of work, a lot of the art needs to be redrawn, and portions of the script need to be rewritten, it would add months to development time. We want to get the game released and the story in people's hands before you all get bored of waiting for our slow-asses.  It may be on the back burner for now, but we haven't canceled or forgotten about it!

Please, let us know what you think! Let us know if we messed something up, report bugs, etc! You can hang out with us and get in touch with us and the rest of the very awesome community super quick via our [url=https://discord.gg/TYV6yBNK4s]Discord[/url]! Come and say hello, we're actually weirdly wholesome. We even do game nights, hang out, watch shows, and shitpost aggressively.

Uuuh, I think that's it! Have a lovely day, everyone!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/K0laUyQ.png[/img]

notes.title: Night's One/Two Development Update
notes.content:
Hello friends! 

From Art Witch Studios, and me personally, I want to wish everyone the merriest of Merry Christmases. I hope you have a good holiday season and eat absurd amounts of food and chocolate until you regret it. I also hope you get to pet the family pets you haven't seen in a while. ♥

It also occurs to me that I haven't posted an update on steam in a while, and if you're not part of our [url=https://discord.gg/TYV6yBNK4s]Discord[/url], you won't have seen us answer these kinds of questions before, so I thought it would be prudent to give everyone an end-of-year update to how things are going on our end.

We're still working hard on Night Two, of course! The original plan was to have the game out sometime before the end of the year, and since that's only a few days away now, it's pretty clear we will unfortunately not be able to make that date. Turns out, this kind of thing always takes longer than expected.  Sorry we're taking so long, it's hard work and life often gets in the way, but we're not slacking, I promise! 

Our new plan is to release [b]Love Sucks: Night Two in the first couple of months of 2022, February, hopefully![/b]  If it looks like we're going to overshoot that, I'll let you know, but that should be enough time! While you wait, you can still add us to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719310/]wishlist[/url] so you don't miss it :D

We're making good progress with the art, and have gotten some extra helpers to help the fantastic Aila color things faster, and let me spend more time working on all her other obligations. If you've been looking at our Twitter lately, you'll see just how nice Night Two's art is gonna be! We're also keeping a few fun things secret, even from patreons.  I think you're gonna love 'em.

Frosto is doing great with the programming, and the script is coming along nicely, we still have to edit it though, just to make sure that we only leave a couple of dozen heinous typos for you to tell us about and for us to fix while being embarrassed about it. Frosto is nice and ahead of the curse, despite having recently adopted a kitten to distract him, and he's been spending some of the extra time making Night One even nicer. We plan to have some more voice lines, and we're going to see about putting achievements into Night One within the next few weeks, fingers crossed!

notes.title: Night One update version 1.16 released!
notes.content:
The update to Night One we've been working on for a while is here! If you want something spooky and sexy to play on your Halloween evening, here it is! The Night One updated includes a couple of bonus scenes, a little bit of lewd, and some expanded plot that introduces a character who will be recurring in future nights! Here's a full changelog:

1. Added two new scenes!
2. Added pictures to other ones
3. Added more music!
-Developed a crossfader so music begins and ends better
-Discovered oggs can be better
-Relooped music!
-Releveled music for optimal listening
4. Fixed Pictures
 -Fixed Dr. B's images
 -Fix Naomi images
5. Added more sound effects
6. Added a sound effect on the right channel so those of you who are crazy and don't love our voice actors should be able to sit in silence.
7. Added so many voice effects
8. Many bug fixes
9. Added Replays that just show the scene
10. Reworked character select
11. Did code work for several things coming up

We wanted it out before Halloween, but we'll take Halloween itself too!  Why did it take longer than we expected? Well, Frosto, the head writer and programmer heard a sad mewing at his apartment door one day, and he took in a little kitten. After finding the owner, he was allowed to keep her! 

This is Callie, and she is the little troublemaker who kept distracting him. 

[url=https://i.imgur.com/iZ6A74U_d.webp?maxwidth=760&fidelity=grand][img]https://i.imgur.com/iZ6A74U_d.webp?maxwidth=760&fidelity=grand[/img][/url]

So what's next? We continue work on Night Two, of course! When is it coming? Well, a lot of things have happened this year, for all of us. It's been quite stressful at times, but work continues at a steady pace. Not as quickly as we were hoping, but sometimes it just be like that, you know? We have more art to finish, more writing to work on, and some more fun bits to program. If we want to make this game without having a stress-induced meltdown by crunching, Night Two is going to be coming out in the early part of 2022, barring any unforeseen circumstances.  As Night Two will be a paid game, I would rather give you (and I'm sure you'd all rather play) a polished game than one we rushed and didn't enjoy working on! 

As always, follow our [url=https://twitter.com/ArtWitchStudios]Twitter [/url]and join our [url=discord.gg/CwQS7U6Swz]Discord [/url]for updates and to hang out with us <3
